content:
Uncategorized Receipts

The Uncategorized Receipts screen displays all receipts that have not yet been allocated to specific accounts.

These receipts are typically imported from bank statements or entered manually without proper account allocation.

Automatic Categorization

The system suggests automatic categorization for uncategorized receipts based on your configured bank rules.

When a receipt matches a bank rule, the suggested account allocation appears in green text, allowing you to quickly review and apply the suggestion.

Bulk Operations

You can select multiple receipts using the checkboxes and click Batch Update to apply the suggested categorizations to all selected receipts at once.

This feature saves time when processing multiple similar transactions that match your bank rules.
